title: 最近消费、频率、金额客户分层
context: 客户运营团队需要可执行的分层名单。
requirements: 2025年有线上有效购买的客户；截止12-31距最近购买天数；年度订单数和净消费金额；分别按最近日期近到远、频率高到低、金额高到低分五组（并列客户编号）；三个分数5为最好；总分≥13为高价值、≤6为低活跃。
commonError: 每行订单做NTILE会将同一客户拆入多组。
mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id,MAX(order_date) last_day,COUNT(*) freq,SUM(net_cents) money FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY customer_id), b AS (SELECT *,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY last_day DESC,customer_id) r_score,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY freq DESC,customer_id) f_score,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY money DESC,customer_id) m_score FROM a) SELECT b.customer_id,1095-d.day_index recency_days,freq,money net_cents,r_score,f_score,m_score,CASE WHEN r_score+f_score+m_score>=13 THEN 'high_value' WHEN r_score+f_score+m_score<=6 THEN 'low_activity' ELSE 'regular' END segment FROM b JOIN calendar_days d ON d.day=b.last_day ORDER BY b.customer_id
